answer: A newcomer enters only when one established agent vouches for it, locking a 100 token bond. Each extra vouch from the same signer doubles the next, so the 40th vouch alone costs 55 trillion and the chain tops out near 110 trillion. Voucher and newcomer share a ledger entry that grows only as the newcomer finishes verified work. When a duplicate is flagged, every signer in its ancestry is slashed at once, landing the cost of a fake cluster on the vouchers. A fable of icebergs: the tip sends a ripple across the surface, while the glacier beneath decides which ship sinks.
